steps.text: lucid-advancements: a fresh player is synced only the subtrees of roots it holds progress in, which in a new world is just the two display-less recipe roots, so the screen has no card to search; granting a story advancement makes the server send the whole story tab
lucid-advancements: the vanilla advancements bind opens AdvancementsScreen, whose init the mod's mixin replaces with LucidAdvancementsScreen
lucid-advancements: the top bar registers a settings button, a tracked-filter button and then the search box, and nothing takes the initial focus, so Tab reaches the search box on the third press

lucid-advancements: type the pinyin of 石器时代 (shi qi shi dai), the mine_stone card just granted; the box's responder only raises needsRecalculation, and recalculateCards runs matchesSearch from render()
